blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] It's fun, so don't make a big thing of it.

gloomy.li: I might forget to be miserable for a whole evening.

cold.li: It should mean fewer arguments at meals.

plain.li: The evenings stay as dull as ever.

warm.li: We'll make our own fun, and stories cost nothing.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'll sit in my room like every other evening.

blunt.li: I'm still bored, and it's making me dangerous.

cheerful.li: My pebble game has seventeen rules now! Please build {THING} before I add more.

gloomy.li: [night] Another evening of staring at the wall, which I know better than some of the people here.

cheerful.li: I'll talk to it every morning! I've heard plants like that.

gloomy.li: Something green to look at when everything else has gone gray. That's not too much, is it.

cold.li: Tending something small keeps me calm. You'd all prefer me calm.
[trait:Psychopath] I like watching things grow. I like deciding what gets pruned. A plant in my room, please.
[skill:Plants] I keep the fields alive for everyone. One plant for myself is a modest fee.

plain.li: I'll overwater it, I know I will.
[morning] Tomorrow the first thing I see will be green.
[promised] You said I'd have it, and here it is by my bed.

warm.li: I'll keep it alive, I promise. I've already moved my bed so it gets the window.

blunt.li: Hands off it, all of you. I do the watering.

cheerful.li: I've put it by the window where it gets the morning sun!
[spring] Seeds in today, and it'll sprout in no time!

gloomy.li: I'll probably kill it, but I'll try.

cold.li: It will thrive. I'll make sure of that.

plain.li: No plant. I'll keep some soil in a bowl and pretend.

[skill:Plants] I'll spend more time in the fields, where the plants are mine to look after.

gloomy.li: Of course. Nothing grows in here.

cold.li: I had the spot measured and everything.

plain.li: [skill:Plants] I keep tracking soil into my room anyway, so it might as well be in a pot.

warm.li: If anyone has a moment, I'm still hoping for something green by my bed.

cheerful.li: I've already picked a name for the plant, and a spot by my bed for it!

gloomy.li: [winter] Everything outside is dead, and there's still nothing green in my room.

blunt.li: I could have it growing in a day if someone built the pot.

plain.li: There's a hole in my shirt right over the heart, and it came with the shirt.

[trait:Beautiful|trait:Pretty] I'm the best-looking person in this colony and I'm dressed in sacking.

[trait:Kind] I'd hand these down to someone who needs them, but they aren't fit to give away.

[repeat] I asked before, and these rags have only gotten worse since.

cheerful.li: I'd love something in a color that isn't mud. Any color, surprise me!
[spring] New season, new clothes! I've had my eye on the cloth in the storeroom.
[highmood] Today's too nice a day to spend in a dead raider's shirt!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I wake up and put on the same torn shirt, and the day starts badly from there.

[trigger:naked] I'm uncovered in front of people I don't trust. Fix that.

plain.li: [winter] {FOR_nameDef} is out in the snow in a shirt meant for summer. Could the tailor make {FOR_objective} something warm?

cheerful.li: {FOR_nameDef} deserves something new, maybe with a hood. I'll pick the color!

plain.li: I keep touching the sleeves to make sure they're whole.

[forother] {PAWN_nameDef} told the council about my rags? I'll thank {PAWN_objective} in person.
[promised] Brand new, like you promised. I'll try not to bleed on them.

warm.li: [child] It fits, and there's room to grow into! Thank you.

blunt.li: Now I look like someone you'd trade with, not someone you'd shoot.

cheerful.li: [spring] New clothes for spring! Who wants to see me twirl?

gloomy.li: Clothes that were made for me, not taken off a body.

cold.li: Clean, and they fit. People will be less suspicious of me now.

plain.li: I'll keep wearing these, holes and all.
[promised] I was told the tailor would get to it, and my elbows are still out in the wind.
[winter] I'll wrap a blanket around myself and call it a coat.

warm.li: Someone else probably needed the cloth more. I hope it went to them.

blunt.li: [trigger:naked] Then I'll take the dead raider's jacket, and hope his friends don't recognize it.

cheerful.li: Rags are just clothes with extra air holes. Very breathable in summer!

gloomy.li: [forother] I asked for {FOR_nameDef}, not for me, and {FOR_pronoun}'s still in rags.

cold.li: Then I'll take clothes off the next raider I kill.

plain.li: Same old rags today, and still no word on "{WISH}".
[trigger:naked] Still nothing to wear but this blanket.

warm.li: [forother] {FOR_nameDef} still hasn't got anything new to wear. I keep thinking about it.

blunt.li: [winter] My shirt's got a new hole and the snow comes in through it.

cheerful.li: My shirt lost another button today! I'm holding it shut with a bit of string.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] These rags again today, and I'm starting to look the way I feel.

plain.li: The animals found {OTHER_nameDef} last night and I chased them off. I can't do that every night.
[trigger:death] I can still hear {OTHER_nameDef}'s voice, and I can't stand to look at the body. Let's bury {OTHER_objective}.
[summer] It's hot, and you know what the heat does. Please, for {OTHER_nameDef}'s sake.
[grieving] I keep setting a place for {OTHER_nameDef} at supper. Help me lay {OTHER_objective} to rest, at least.
[repeat] {OTHER_nameDef} is still out there. Nothing has changed since I asked, except the smell.

warm.li: Let's do this one last thing for {OTHER_nameDef}, while we still can.
[child] Is {OTHER_nameDef} going to stay out there all alone? Can we put {OTHER_objective} in the ground, where it's safe?
[trait:Kind] {OTHER_nameDef} was kind to me when I first came here. The least I can do is see {OTHER_objective} properly buried.

blunt.li: [trigger:death] We don't leave our own lying in the mud. Bury {OTHER_nameDef}.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would hate all this attention. Let's give {OTHER_objective} a quiet spot with a nice view.
[spring] {OTHER_nameDef} loved the spring. Let's bury {OTHER_objective} somewhere the flowers come up.
I've been telling {OTHER_nameDef}'s funniest stories at supper. Let's put {OTHER_objective} somewhere we can visit and tell more.

gloomy.li: Every day {OTHER_nameDef} lies out there, it gets easier to picture myself in {OTHER_possessive} place.
[night] I dreamed {OTHER_nameDef} asked me why we left {OTHER_objective} out there. I didn't have an answer.
[snow] The snow's covering {OTHER_nameDef} now. It'll all come back in the thaw.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was useful. Burying the useful ones properly keeps the rest working.

plain.li: I'll put a stone there tomorrow, and another the day after.

[petition] All of us who asked for this will say goodbye together. {OTHER_nameDef} would have liked that.
[promised] {OTHER_nameDef} is laid to rest, like you promised. Thank you for that.

warm.li: I promised {OTHER_nameDef} we'd look after each other. We will.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is out of the weather. Now leave me alone for a while.

cheerful.li: I'm going to tell one of {OTHER_nameDef}'s awful jokes when we say goodbye.

gloomy.li: [night] I'll sit there a while tonight. It might be quieter in my head.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s belongings should be shared out now. I've started a list.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still out there, and I've stopped walking that way.

[night] I went and sat with {OTHER_nameDef} tonight, so {OTHER_pronoun} wouldn't be alone out there.

warm.li: I've put a blanket over {OTHER_nameDef}, which is the best I can do.

blunt.li: [trigger:death] I'll dig it myself tonight, and don't any of you try to stop me.

cheerful.li: I keep telling myself {OTHER_nameDef} would laugh about all this.

gloomy.li: [grieving] So that's what we're worth here.

cold.li: So bodies stay where they fall here, and I'll make my own arrangements.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still lying out there, and I'm asking again.

warm.li: [petition] We're all still waiting to say a proper goodbye to {OTHER_nameDef}.

blunt.li: [summer] It's getting hot. Bury {OTHER_nameDef} before the smell does the asking for me.

gloomy.li: [night] Couldn't sleep for thinking of {OTHER_nameDef} out there under the open sky.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s body is still out there, and it gets harder to move every day it's left.

warm.li: I think I can stop flinching at every sound now.

blunt.li: When the Empire asks why I live in squalor, I'll be giving them names.

cheerful.li: Rustic can be noble too! I'll tell the Empire it's the new fashion.

gloomy.li: The title is still mine. Everything that's meant to go with it, apparently, isn't.

cold.li: Noted. My cooperation will be calibrated to my circumstances.

plain.li: My {SUBJECT} is still not fit for my rank. I'd like that seen to, with respect.

blunt.li: Have you looked at my {SUBJECT}? Look at it. Then look at my title.

cheerful.li: I've been rehearsing how I'll greet guests in my new {SUBJECT}. Is it nearly ready?

cold.li: [repeat] I have raised the matter of my {SUBJECT} before. I would prefer not to raise it a third time.

warm.li: I hate to keep mentioning my {SUBJECT}, but the title won't let me stop.

plain.li: I asked a grown-up how the stars work, but they were too busy to tell me. Could we get {THING}?
[rain] It's raining, and every grown-up says "not now." With {THING}, I'd stop asking.
[afterraid] The loud bad people came again. I want something fun to think about instead.
[repeat] I asked before and you said maybe. Maybe is almost yes!

warm.li: If I had {THING}, I could learn stuff and help more, like the big people do.
[grieving] I'm sad all the time since they died. Maybe if I had {THING}, I'd think about it less.
[trait:Kind] If I had {THING}, I'd show you all everything I learned.

blunt.li: Grown-ups get workbenches and weapons, and I get a corner. All I want is {THING}.
[trait:Abrasive] I'm not going to be good until I get {THING}. That's the deal.
[afterraid] I helped carry stuff during the raid, so I should get {THING}.

cheerful.li: I'll draw you a picture every single day if I get {THING}!
[snow] I made a snow person and it fell over! Now I need something to do inside, where my fingers work.
[highmood] I'm so happy today, and I'd be even happier with {THING}!

gloomy.li: Everybody's too busy to play with me. Maybe {THING} wouldn't be.
[lowmood] I don't want to be in the way. If I had {THING}, I'd stay out of the way. Promise.

cold.li: If I learn more, I'll be useful sooner. Useful people don't get left behind.
[trait:Psychopath] Can I have {THING}? I'll be very quiet if I get it. I'm good at quiet.

plain.li: I'm going to sit here all day and learn a new word, then another one!
[evening] I don't want to go to bed yet. Can I stay up a bit longer?
[promised] You said yes and you really meant it!

warm.li: Thank you! I'll take good care of it, and I'll let the others have turns.

blunt.li: Finally. I thought you'd forgotten.

cheerful.li: Can I show it to everybody? Right now?

gloomy.li: It's really mine? You won't take it back?

cold.li: I'll learn everything on it, and then everything else.

plain.li: I'll play with rocks again, because rocks are always there.
[promised] You promised! I'm never believing a grown-up promise again.
[afterraid] The grown-ups were all busy with the raid, I know. I still wanted it.

warm.li: That's all right. I know the grown-ups are busy keeping us alive.

blunt.li: Then I'm going to be bored, loudly, right where you're working.

cheerful.li: I'll pretend the woodpile is a castle! A very lumpy castle.

gloomy.li: I knew it. Kids don't count here.

cold.li: I'll remember this. I remember everything.

plain.li: Is {THING} done yet? Is it done now? How about now?

warm.li: I've been really, really good lately. Just saying, about {THING}.

blunt.li: Hello? I asked for {THING} ages ago.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I don't think anyone's making {THING}, so I'll stop asking, maybe.

cheerful.li: I've counted to a hundred twice waiting for {THING}. Is it ready yet?

plain.li: I've been doing my best work standing up, in the rain, with borrowed tools. Think what I'd do with {SUBJECT}.
[trusting] You've backed me before. Back me on {SUBJECT} and you won't regret it.
[newcomer] I didn't come all this way to do half a job. I need {SUBJECT}.
[repeat] I'll keep bringing up {SUBJECT} until it's built.

warm.li: I'd teach anyone who wants to learn, if we had {SUBJECT}.
[old] I've got a few good working years left in me. I want to spend them in {SUBJECT}.
[trusting] I've never asked for much, so you know I mean it about {SUBJECT}.

blunt.li: Every time I get going, somebody walks through my work to reach the stockpile. I need {SUBJECT} with a door on it.
[trait:Abrasive] I'm good at this, and I'm done pretending a dirt floor will do instead of {SUBJECT}.
[afterraid] We nearly died yesterday. If I go, I want some good work behind me, done in {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I dreamed about {SUBJECT} last night and woke up grinning! Let's build it.
[highmood] I feel like I could do anything today. Give me {SUBJECT} and I'll prove it!

gloomy.li: Some days the work is the only thing keeping me sane. Working like this, even that's slipping.
[lowmood] Give me {SUBJECT} and maybe I'll remember why I bothered learning any of this.
[winter] A long gray winter, and nowhere to do the only thing that helps. I need {SUBJECT}.

cold.li: You keep the best worker in the worst corner. I'd like {SUBJECT}, and I'd like it organized my way.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't love many things. I love this work. That should tell you how serious I am about {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: I'll be in there all night, so someone call me for breakfast.
[petition] All of you who backed this, come and see it. You'll be the first to benefit.
[promised] I half thought you'd forget. I'll make every stone of it worth the trouble.

warm.li: Come by whenever you like. I've already set aside a stool for visitors.

blunt.li: Don't expect to see me at supper.

cheerful.li: [morning] Tomorrow I'll be up before anyone else, working in the best room in the colony!

gloomy.li: Maybe I'll make something I'm proud of again.

cold.li: This will pay for itself within the season. Mark the date.

plain.li: [promised] I've been sketching {SUBJECT} in the dirt. The dirt's all I was given.
So I'll keep working wherever there's a gap, and moving when someone needs it.

warm.li: I'll teach someone what I know instead, in case I never get to do it properly.

blunt.li: Don't ask me for anything good, then. You haven't earned it.

cheerful.li: No matter! I've made my corner very cozy. It has a rug now.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I used to love this. I'm not sure I'll love it much longer.
[winter] Another winter of working on my knees by the door, where the draft gets in.

cold.li: Very well. Adequate work in an inadequate space. Don't mistake it for my best.

plain.li: Still waiting on {SUBJECT}, and losing half an hour a day just finding my tools.

warm.li: [petition] A few of us are still hoping for {SUBJECT}. We'd all use it, I promise.

blunt.li: You know what I asked for, and it still isn't built.

cheerful.li: I've added three more rooms to my plans for {SUBJECT}! Maybe we could build the first one?

gloomy.li: [night] Lay awake planning {SUBJECT} again. It's nicer in my head than it'll ever be out here.

cold.li: I'm still producing a fraction of what I could. You're still paying for that.

plain.li: I watched someone do {SUBJECT} today, badly, and I bit my tongue the whole time. Let me do it.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] My hands don't know what to do with themselves when they're not doing {SUBJECT}.
[newcomer] Back home, {SUBJECT} was what I did. I'd like it to be what I do here too.
[repeat] Me again, about {SUBJECT}. I'm being more polite than I feel.

warm.li: Let me take some {SUBJECT} off someone else's hands. I'd enjoy it, and they'd get a rest.
[trusting] I trust your judgment on who does what. I'd just like a turn at {SUBJECT}.
[old] I've been doing {SUBJECT} longer than some of you have been alive. Let me keep my hand in.

blunt.li: I didn't survive this long to haul rocks all day. Let me do {SUBJECT}.
[bitter] Anyone in this colony can do {SUBJECT} except me, and I'm the one who loves it.
[afterraid] The raid showed what happens when the wrong people do the wrong work. Put me on {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I've been doing {SUBJECT} in my head all week. I'm amazing at it in my head!
[highmood] I'm in such a good mood I could do {SUBJECT} all day. Can I, please?
[spring] New season, new start! Put me down for {SUBJECT}.

gloomy.li: All day I do work I'm bad at and watch work I'm good at done badly.
[winter] A whole winter of hauling and cleaning. Some {SUBJECT} would keep me from going strange.

cold.li: You're using a scalpel to dig ditches. Put me on {SUBJECT}.
[trait:Psychopath] I'm calmer when I'm doing {SUBJECT}. You've seen me when I'm not.

plain.li: I'll be tired tonight from {SUBJECT}, and it'll be the good kind.
[morning] I know what I'll be doing today. Best feeling there is.
[promised] Back on {SUBJECT}, just like you said. I didn't think you'd remember.

warm.li: You won't be sorry you trusted me with it.

blunt.li: About time. Now watch how it's done.

cheerful.li: I'm on {SUBJECT} now, and I might forget to eat!

gloomy.li: Maybe for a few hours I'll stop thinking about everything else.

cold.li: Correct allocation. You'll see the results.

plain.li: [promised] I was supposed to be doing {SUBJECT} by now. I'm still sweeping floors.
Somebody else is still on {SUBJECT}, so I'll stop offering.

warm.li: Whoever's doing {SUBJECT} instead, I hope they're enjoying it as much as I would have.
[trusting] I'm sure there's a good reason I'm not on {SUBJECT}. I'd still like to hear it someday.

blunt.li: Enjoy whatever mess the others make of {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: I'll just be the best hauler in the colony instead!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Back to being useless.

cold.li: Then my skills will rot, and that's your loss, not mine.

plain.li: Still not on {SUBJECT}, and I think about it every day.

blunt.li: Just watched {SUBJECT} get done wrong again.

cheerful.li: Still ready for {SUBJECT} whenever you are!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I've stopped watching them do {SUBJECT} because it hurts too much.

warm.li: Whenever you're shuffling the work around, I'd still love a turn at {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: We eat every meal staring at the same blank wall. A statue would help the food go down.
[skill:Artistic] I've got a block of stone and an idea. Give me a place where people will actually see it.
[afterraid] After today, I'd like to look up at supper and see something that isn't a bloodstain.
[repeat] The walls haven't gotten any less blank since I last brought it up.

warm.li: I'd love something beautiful in the dining room, something we made out here.
[winter] The winter is gray enough. Our dining room doesn't need to be.
[grieving] A carving in the dining room would help us remember the ones who used to eat with us.

blunt.li: Our rec room looks worse than some prisons I've seen.
[trait:Greedy] Other settlements have statues in their halls, and we have bare walls. It's embarrassing.
[trait:Abrasive] I don't care about art. I care that the dining room is so ugly it ruins my appetite.

cheerful.li: We need a statue! I don't mind of what, as long as it has a big nose.
[highmood] Let's make the dining room so fancy that raiders stop to admire it!

gloomy.li: Someday someone will find this place, and there should be something here worth finding.
[lowmood] Blank walls and gray faces at every meal. A statue won't fix that, but it might help.

cold.li: Visitors judge us by our common rooms, and right now they'd judge us poor.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't feel much looking at art. Other people do. That's useful, so let's have some.
[rich] Our wealth sits in the storeroom where no visitor ever sees it.

plain.li: People will stop mid-bite at supper just to look at it.
[petition] We all asked for it. Now we all get to argue about what it means.
[promised] The art's up, just as you said. The dining room looks like somewhere people live now.

warm.li: It's lovely, and people will smile at it on their way past.

blunt.li: It's good, so don't ask me to explain why.

cheerful.li: [evening] I'm naming it at supper tonight! The others will hate the name.

gloomy.li: It's the only thing here that isn't trying to survive. It just stands there being nice to look at.

cold.li: Morale should rise measurably.

plain.li: [promised] The wall's still bare, and it was supposed to have art on it by now.
I'll carve my initials in the dining table and call it art.
[skill:Artistic] I'll carve something myself, and don't blame me if it comes out angry.

warm.li: The people are the nicest thing in that room anyway. I'll look at them.

blunt.li: So we keep eating in a gray box.

cheerful.li: I'll stand very still in the corner of the dining room. I'm the art now!

gloomy.li: I don't know why I thought anything beautiful would happen out here.

cold.li: Unfortunate. The cheapest morale improvement available, ignored.

plain.li: We're still eating in front of blank walls, still hoping for "{WISH}".

warm.li: [petition] A few of us keep eyeing that empty corner of the dining room and thinking the same thing.

cheerful.li: I've picked the perfect spot for the statue, right in front of the blank wall!

gloomy.li: [evening] Another supper with the bare walls, and I've started seeing faces in them.

blunt.li: Dining room's still ugly, in case anyone's forgotten.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] It failed me twice in that fight, and a third time would kill me. A proper {SUBJECT}, please.
[trait:Brawler] I'm no good with things that shoot. Get me something heavy to hit them with.
[skill:Shooting,!trait:Brawler] I can shoot. This thing can't. Give me a {SUBJECT} that keeps up with me.
[repeat] My weapon didn't fix itself while you were deciding. I'm asking again.

warm.li: I'm not after glory. I just want to be able to stand in front of the others when it matters.
[afterraid] I saw who they went for in that raid. Next time I want to stop them first. A real {SUBJECT}, please.
[trait:Kind] I don't like fighting, but if I have to, I'd rather it was over fast. A decent {SUBJECT} would see to that.

blunt.li: This thing I carry is an insult to the person I took it from.
[trait:Bloodlust] Get me something that finishes the job the first time.

cheerful.li: I've been practicing my battle cry, and it deserves a better {SUBJECT}!
[skill:Melee] Give me a real {SUBJECT} and I'll make the next raid a story worth telling!
[trait:Bloodlust] A better {SUBJECT} means more fun for me and less for them!

gloomy.li: When I go, I'd like it to be because they were better. Not because my weapon was worse.
[hurt] Look at me. This is what this weapon got me.
[afterraid] A raider's weapon outclassed mine all through that fight. I won't be so lucky twice.

cold.li: The raiders carry better equipment than I do, and that should be the other way around.
[trigger:raid] One of them got away today because of this weapon. I don't like leaving things unfinished.

plain.li: I'll be out practicing with it before supper.
[afterraid] I wish I'd had this yesterday.
[promised] Next raid, you'll see exactly what keeping your promise bought.

warm.li: I'll keep it clean, and I'll keep the rest of you safe.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Oh, they're going to hate this. I'm going to love it.

cheerful.li: I'm carrying it around the perimeter twice, just to carry it!

gloomy.li: I might survive the next raid now.

cold.li: Good balance, good weight. The next raid will be shorter.

plain.li: [promised] So it's this junk again for the next raid. I hope it holds.
[trigger:raid] I'll take something off a dead raider next time. It's quicker than waiting.

warm.li: I'll still stand in front of the others when they come, just not as well.

blunt.li: When I'm out there swinging junk, think of me.
[bitter] So I'll die holding junk, and you'll keep your silver.

cheerful.li: This old thing has character! Most of it is rust.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] If this thing gets me killed, I hope it's quick.

cold.li: Accepted. My kill rate stays where it is. So does theirs.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] Still carrying the junk I fought with last time, so about that {SUBJECT}.

blunt.li: This won't hold up in the next fight, so where's my {SUBJECT}?

cheerful.li: My battle cry is ready, but my weapon isn't!

gloomy.li: [night] Cleaned this sorry weapon again tonight. Still sorry.

cold.li: My weapon remains substandard. Raids do not wait for procurement.

plain.li: We grow our own food and sew our own clothes, but we don't brew. Feels like we skipped a step.
[trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] It's been a long time since I had anything at all. Beer is the gentle option. Think about it.
[fall] The harvest's in. It'd be a shame not to turn some of it into something worth drinking.
[repeat] The harvests keep coming in and none of it is becoming beer. I'm bringing it up again.

warm.li: A barrel of our own beer would be something to share, with guests or with each other.
[evening] I'd love to sit outside after supper with a mug each, talking about anything but raids.
[winter] A mug of our own beer on a winter night would carry a lot of us through to spring.

blunt.li: I'm not asking for anything strong. I'm asking for beer. Be glad it's only beer.
[afterraid] We survived that raid and toasted with water. Let's have {THING} before the next one.

cheerful.li: I've already drawn the mark for our barrels, a winking muffalo! Please build {THING}.
[summer] Hot day, cold beer! Can we, please?
[highmood] Days like this deserve a toast, and we've got nothing to toast with!

gloomy.li: It's been a dry year in every sense. I'd like one drink before it's out.
[lowmood] One beer and one evening where things feel far away. Is that so much to ask?

cold.li: A colony with beer complains less. I've noticed.
[trait:Psychopath] Drunk people are easier to read. I like a colony I can read. Let's brew.
[trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] I can control myself. A barrel here at home keeps me from looking elsewhere.

plain.li: Beer at last, and I'm fussing over it like a newborn.
[petition] The ones who asked for it get the first mugs. That's only fair.
[promised] Beer, like you promised. The first mug's named after the council.

warm.li: Come and find me tonight, the first mug's on me.

blunt.li: Hands off the beer until supper, mine included.

cheerful.li: [evening] Tonight we toast, and I've been practicing mine all week!

gloomy.li: Something to look forward to that isn't a raid.

cold.li: Beer keeps people pliable. Good.

plain.li: [promised] A promised brewery. I'll just drink the promise, then.
I'll drink muddy water and pretend it's aged.
[evening] Another evening, another cup of water, and I toast it out of spite.

warm.li: We'll toast with whatever's in the cup.

blunt.li: [bitter] This council can't even manage a barrel.

cheerful.li: Fine by me! I'm going to try fermenting berries in a bucket.

gloomy.li: Another long dry season ahead, like all of them here.

cold.li: Morale will fall faster than it needed to, and I'll watch it happen.

plain.li: Still no beer, and a barrel would take one afternoon.

blunt.li: We still don't have a brewery, you know, the thing that makes beer.

cheerful.li: [evening] Every evening I think how perfect a beer would be right now!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Still dry, and some evenings that's harder than others.

warm.li: [petition] A few of us are still dreaming about that first mug.

plain.li: [trigger:rawfood] I chewed a raw muffalo steak for ten minutes and lost the fight.
[trigger:sick] I was sick all night after yesterday's meal. Could we have {SUBJECT}, made properly?
[industrial|spacer] We've got machines that can do almost anything, and we eat like we crashed here yesterday. We could at least manage {SUBJECT}.
[repeat] I'm bringing up {SUBJECT} again because I'm still eating like a scavenger.

warm.li: The cooks work so hard. If they had time for {SUBJECT}, I think it would cheer them up too.
[old] A warm meal that doesn't fight back, that's all I want. My teeth aren't what they were.
[grieving] Food's the one thing that's comforted me lately. A good meal would help.

blunt.li: [trigger:rawfood] Raw again, and I'm not a muffalo.
[trait:Gourmand] I'll cook it myself if I have to, and nobody wants that. Get the cooks making {SUBJECT}.

cheerful.li: If we have {SUBJECT} tonight, I'll do the dishes for a week!
[trigger:sick] I've stopped throwing up, and now I'm starving! Could we have {SUBJECT}?
[highmood] What a day! It'd be perfect with {SUBJECT} for supper.

gloomy.li: I don't remember what food is supposed to taste like. Something other than this, I think.
[trigger:rawfood] Eating raw food like an animal. All this way, for this.

cold.li: [trigger:sick] Food poisoning took me off work for a day. A clean kitchen and {SUBJECT} prevent that.
Good food keeps people agreeable, and agreeable people are easier to manage.
[trait:Gourmand] I can tell when a cook is being lazy. Ours is being lazy, and I'd like {SUBJECT} for a change.

plain.li: This one I'm eating slowly, so it lasts.
[trigger:rawfood] Something cooked at last. My jaw thanks you.
[promised] You promised {SUBJECT}, and I'm having two.

warm.li: Where's the cook? I want to say thank you myself.

blunt.li: [trait:Gourmand] Real food, and don't stop now.

cheerful.li: [evening] Supper tonight, and I'm licking the plate clean!

gloomy.li: [trigger:sick] Food that won't make me sick. I'd forgotten that was an option.

cold.li: Better food, better output. Keep that cook in the kitchen.

plain.li: [promised] I was expecting {SUBJECT}. I got a handful of raw berries. I don't think that's what anyone meant.
Back to eating whatever's quickest and least likely to kill me.

warm.li: The cooks have enough on their plates already. I'll manage.
[trigger:rawfood] I'll ask the cook to teach me something simple, which beats chewing it raw.

blunt.li: [trigger:sick] So I go on guessing which meal will make me sick.

cheerful.li: Raw food is just food that's very shy!

gloomy.li: Same food tomorrow, and the day after, and the day after that.

cold.li: Then morale will keep falling at mealtimes. I've stopped expecting otherwise.

plain.li: [trigger:rawfood] Ate raw again today, so any news on {SUBJECT}?

warm.li: [petition] A lot of us would love {SUBJECT}, even just once.

blunt.li: [trait:Gourmand] Still eating slop, and I've nearly forgotten what flavor is.

cheerful.li: I keep imagining {SUBJECT} in great detail. Please hurry!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Another meal I didn't taste.

plain.li: I threw out a whole crate of berries this morning, all of them furred with mold. We need cold storage.
[skill:Cooking] I can't plan a single meal when half the pantry rots before the week's out.
[summer] The flies have moved into the storeroom, and there are more every day. We need a freezer.
[repeat] Since I last asked, we've thrown out enough food to feed a caravan.

warm.li: [skill:Plants] I'd love to see what I grow make it all the way to the table. A freezer, please?
If we lose the harvest to spoilage, we'll go hungry by winter. I'd rather none of us did.
[skill:Cooking] I'd love to cook with fresh ingredients for once. It's the difference between a meal and a ration.

blunt.li: [summer] Something in the storeroom is moving, and it isn't a squirrel.
I'm done picking maggots out of my dinner. We need a freezer, today.

cheerful.li: A freezer means ice! I'm sure we could think of something fun to do with ice.
[hot] It's so hot out. I'd volunteer to stack the freezer every day!
[spring] Let's build a freezer before summer comes! We'll be so glad we did.

gloomy.li: Everything here rots eventually. The food's just faster about it.
[summer] Food rots in summer and we starve in winter. It's not complicated.
[lowmood] Opened the storeroom and the smell hit me like a sledgehammer. I closed the door again and walked away.

cold.li: If we run short this winter, we'll have to decide who eats. I'd rather skip that conversation. A freezer, please.
[trait:Psychopath] Cold keeps meat fresh for months. Any kind of meat. A freezer is practical.

plain.li: The meat in there is just meat now, and it'll stay that way.
[summer] Midsummer, and the food will keep.
[promised] The food's fresh and the flies are furious. Thank you for keeping your word.

warm.li: Next harvest, every basket makes it to the table.

blunt.li: Anyone who leaves the freezer door open answers to me.

cheerful.li: [hot] The freezer is my new favorite place to stand. Don't mind me!

gloomy.li: We might actually make it through the winter now.

cold.li: I'll be taking inventory, so don't take extra.

plain.li: [promised] We were meant to have a freezer. The meat didn't wait for it.
I'll eat the oldest food first and pray.
[summer] I threw out another crate this morning, and I'm too tired to be angry.

warm.li: I'll dry what I can, and every bit saved helps.

blunt.li: [summer] I'm eating outside from now on, away from that storeroom.

cheerful.li: Fresh food tastes best anyway, so we'll all just eat faster!

gloomy.li: So we watch it rot, and then we go hungry.

cold.li: Then we'll lose food, and after that we'll lose people.

plain.li: [summer] More food went off this morning, and I'm still hoping for "{WISH}".

warm.li: [petition] All of us in the kitchen are still asking, and the food's still spoiling.

blunt.li: Smell that? That's another meal nobody froze.

cheerful.li: There's green fuzz growing on the bread! Freezer, please?

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Something else rotted today. I didn't even look to see what.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked and I said yes. Now we need a quiet day and somewhere to stand.
[summer] A summer wedding, before the harvest. Short and sweet, like the season.
[old] I never thought I'd marry, at my age. {OTHER_nameDef} changed my mind. Let's not wait.
[repeat] I'm asking again. {OTHER_nameDef} has started picking flowers just in case.

warm.li: I want all of us there, even the ones who grumble about weddings.
[grieving] We've lost people. {OTHER_nameDef} and I would like to give the colony one day where we gain something instead.
[trusting] You've looked after us so well. Give us one day, and we'll make it a good one for all of us.

blunt.li: We're engaged, not dead. Let's get on with it.
[trait:Abrasive] I'm marrying {OTHER_nameDef}. Anyone who objects can say so at the ceremony and see what happens.
[winter] A snow wedding suits me fine, with cold hands and short vows.

cheerful.li: I've picked the spot and the song! I just need one day without raiders.
[spring] A spring wedding, with flowers on the animals too!
[highmood] I'm so happy I could marry {OTHER_nameDef} today! Is today good?

gloomy.li: Every day I wait to marry {OTHER_nameDef} is another day for something to go wrong.
[lowmood] Everything's falling apart. I'd like to marry {OTHER_nameDef} before it finishes.

cold.li: Marriage makes it formal. {OTHER_nameDef} will be mine, officially. I'd like that settled.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't entirely understand weddings. {OTHER_nameDef} wants one, and I want {OTHER_objective} content.

plain.li: I can't stop looking at {OTHER_nameDef}, my spouse.

gloomy.li: [afterraid] Another close call, and still no wedding.

blunt.li: Still engaged, still waiting, and neither of us is getting any younger.

[spring] A spring birthday, with everything growing! A {SUBJECT} would make it perfect.

[lowmood] You don't need to make a fuss. A {SUBJECT} would be nice, if anyone has the time.

[trait:Psychopath] Birthdays mean nothing to me. They mean a great deal to the others, and the others watch how you treat me.

plain.li: A year older and I don't even mind. Thank you.
[evening] A good meal on my birthday, and the evening's not over yet.
[promised] I didn't think anyone would really remember, and you did.

warm.li: Of all the days to eat well, this was the right one.

blunt.li: Good food, and no one died. That's a birthday.

cheerful.li: [child] I'm going to stay this age forever!

gloomy.li: For one evening I won't think about how many more I'll get.

cold.li: Acknowledged and celebrated. I'll remember who did the cooking.

plain.li: My birthday came and went while I hauled stone, same as the day before.
[promised] I was told there'd be a {SUBJECT}. I ate leftovers and blew out a candle by myself.

warm.li: I got older all the same, which is the important part.
[child] That's all right, I had a birthday in my head, and it was nice in there.

blunt.li: Happy birthday to me, then, since no one else bothered.

cheerful.li: I'll just have my birthday again tomorrow, and keep at it until somebody notices!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Another year gone, and I barely noticed it myself.

cold.li: So my birthday is not considered relevant. I'll treat yours the same way.

plain.li: My birthday's nearly here, and I'm still hoping for a {SUBJECT}.

blunt.li: Birthday's soon, and any kind of feast beats nothing.

cheerful.li: Only a few days till my birthday! I'll be reminding people every hour.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] My birthday's soon, and I won't mind if it's forgotten.

warm.li: [old] At my age birthdays matter, so here's a small reminder about mine.

[skill:Artistic] Everything I carve, I see the mistakes in. I'd like a piece by someone else to look at.
[winter] Months indoors staring at the same walls. A sculpture would give my eyes somewhere to go.
[repeat] My walls are still blank, and I'm still lying in bed looking at them.

warm.li: If someone's carving something anyway, I'd love it if it could live in my room.
[old] At my age the evenings are long. One beautiful thing to look at would help pass them.
[grieving] When I miss them at night, I'd like to have something beautiful to look at.

blunt.li: A sculpture in my room, not another blank wall.
[trait:Jealous] I've seen the statue in someone else's room. I want one, and I want it bigger.
[trait:Greedy] Put something on my wall that's worth more than I am. I'll feel richer just looking at it.

cheerful.li: With a sculpture in my room I'd have people over just to see it!
[highmood] Today's a good day, and good days deserve a good sculpture!
[spring] I'd love a sculpture of a flower in my room, for spring!

gloomy.li: Something beautiful, so the last thing I see each night isn't a wall.
[lowmood] Maybe if I had something lovely to look at, I'd stop staring at the ceiling.

cold.li: A good piece in my room, please. People should see what I'm worth when they walk in.
[trait:Psychopath] Other people cry at sculptures. I'd like one in my room to study, every night, until I understand why.

plain.li: I could sit and look at it until the light goes.
[morning] I'll be late to breakfast tomorrow, looking at it.
[promised] I'd stopped believing it would come, and now it's standing by my bed. Thank you.

warm.li: Whoever made it, I'd like to thank them. It's beautiful.

blunt.li: Don't touch it, and don't even breathe on it.

cheerful.li: Every time I pass my room now, I'm stopping to say hello to it!

gloomy.li: It's lovely. I don't know what I did to deserve something lovely.

cold.li: Competent work. It suits me. I'll keep it.

plain.li: I'll hang my coat on the wall and squint at it.
[promised] I was promised something beautiful. My wall is still just a wall.
[lowmood] Bare walls again tonight, like the inside of my head.

warm.li: Maybe someday a piece will turn up that nobody else wants. I'll wait for that one.

blunt.li: My room stays ugly, and so does my mood.

cheerful.li: I drew a face on the wall with charcoal! It's art if you squint.

gloomy.li: Beautiful things are for other people, I knew that.

cold.li: I'll remember whose rooms got the art.

plain.li: My walls are still bare, in case anyone's thinking about sculptures.

warm.li: If there's ever a spare piece in the storeroom, my room would give it a good home.

cheerful.li: The spot by my bed is still empty and still waiting!

gloomy.li: [night] Lying in bed, staring at the same bare wall, still hoping.

blunt.li: Still no art in my room, and I could draw you the wall from memory.

plain.li: I fell asleep standing up at the stockpile, leaning on a crate. I need a few hours off.
[summer] It's too nice out to spend every hour hauling. Give me one afternoon in the sun.
[hurt] I'm still healing and I'm still working full days. Some rest, please.
[repeat] I'm more tired now than the last time I asked.

warm.li: Just an hour to sit with friends and not be useful, that would be lovely.
[trusting] I know there's always more work, but I think I need a break.
[grieving] I've been working so I don't have to think. I think I need to stop and think, just for a bit.

blunt.li: I've worked every hour the sun's up and a few it isn't. Give me time off, or I take it.
[trait:Abrasive] The lot of you are getting on my nerves, which means I need a break.

cheerful.li: An afternoon in the grass, watching clouds, is all I'd ask!
[spring] The flowers are out, and I'd like to be out with them, not hauling stone!
[highmood] I'm in a wonderful mood. Let me spend it somewhere other than the stockpile!

gloomy.li: My hands shake by evening. I don't think that's normal. Some rest might help.
[lowmood] I'm so tired I've stopped noticing I'm tired. That's when it goes bad.

cold.li: I've worked more hours this month than anyone here. That should be balanced, with rest.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't need rest, but my temper does. Keep that in mind.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] Rest is wasted time, normally. Lately I've been dropping things, so call it maintenance.

plain.li: Sitting in the sun doing nothing, starting now.
[evening] A whole evening to myself, and I don't know what to do with it.
[promised] Time to myself, as promised. I'll probably sleep through all of it.

warm.li: I'll spend my free hours with friends I haven't talked to properly in weeks.

blunt.li: Don't come looking for me during my hours.

cheerful.li: Nap first, everything else later!

gloomy.li: Maybe I'll wake up tomorrow and not dread it.

cold.li: My work will be cleaner once I've rested.

plain.li: [promised] I was promised some rest. I'm still waiting, and still tired.
Back to work, and I'll sleep standing up if I have to.
[hurt] So I go back to full days with the stitches still in.

warm.li: We're all working hard. I can keep going a while longer.

blunt.li: When I nap in the middle of a field, don't wake me.

cheerful.li: No break? I'll just take tiny ones between jobs!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Work, then, until something breaks, and it'll probably be me.

cold.li: Then expect the quality of my work to reflect my condition.

plain.li: Still working every hour there is, and still hoping for a few of them back.

blunt.li: Nearly fell asleep with a knife in my hand today, just so you know.

cheerful.li: I've planned my time off in detail! It's mostly lying down.

gloomy.li: [night] Still awake, and up again in a few hours, still waiting on "{WISH}".

warm.li: I'm still running on very little. A few hours off, whenever you can manage it.

plain.li: A joint, a beer, anything. Something to sit with at the end of the day.
[trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] I'm not going to do anything stupid. I'd just like the option of something mild in the stockpile.
[storm] Thunder all night and nothing to settle the nerves. Some smokeleaf, maybe? A beer?
[repeat] Back again about the stockpile. It's still dry, and so am I.

[grieving] I'd like to raise a glass to the ones we've lost. We don't have anything to put in the glass.
[trusting] I know you'll be sensible about it. Just a small supply, for when things get hard.

[bitter] You want me less bitter? Give me something to drink. It's the cheapest fix you've got.

cheerful.li: Let's have a small party, with a bit of beer! Or a lot of beer.
[evening] Evenings are for stories and something to sip. We've already got the stories!
[highmood] Great mood, great company, and nothing to drink! Let's fix the last one.

gloomy.li: Some nights I need the edges filed off. Tonight's one of those.
[lowmood] Nothing helps much anymore. A drink helps for an evening.

[trait:Psychopath] I don't need it. The others do, and I have to live with the others.

[evening] Sitting outside after supper with a mug and nothing to do. Exactly right.
[promised] A little something, like you said. Cheers to the council.

warm.li: I'll share it around, starting with whoever had the worst week.

blunt.li: Leave me alone with this for a while.

cheerful.li: Here's to this mug, and the next one!

gloomy.li: Tonight the edges can blur for a while.

cold.li: Stock replenished. Tensions should drop.

plain.li: Dry, then. I'll survive it, grumpily.
[promised] A little something, I was promised. I got a little nothing.
[evening] Another dry evening, so I tell stories about beer instead.

warm.li: We'll sit together in the evenings anyway. Someone always has a story.

blunt.li: [trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] I know where the traders camp, so don't ask what I'll trade.

cheerful.li: Water it is, and very refreshing too!

gloomy.li: Another long, sober night ahead.

cold.li: Tempers will fray faster now. I'll stay clear of whoever breaks first.

plain.li: [evening] Another evening with nothing to drink, and still asking about "{WISH}".

blunt.li: The stockpile's still dry, in case you hadn't noticed.

cheerful.li: My mug's been empty so long a spider moved in!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] It's getting harder to wind down at night, just so you know.

warm.li: [trusting] Not trying to nag, just still hoping for a little something in the stockpile.

[promised] You said you'd give {OTHER_nameDef} a chance. Look how that turned out.

warm.li: I knew there was someone worth knowing in there. Welcome, {OTHER_nameDef}.

cheerful.li: I'll keep visiting the cell and bring something to play with!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} will rot in there or leave, and either way not with us.
